⚙ Settings & API Keys
Display & Accessibility
How to get it: Go to console.anthropic.com → Sign up/log in → API Keys → Create Key. Paste it above. Stored locally in your browser only. Used for AI plan generation in Entrepreneur tab.
Free tier works without a key. For higher rate limits: go to coingecko.com/en/api → Sign up → Demo API key. Used for live crypto prices.
Go to metals-api.com → Sign up for free tier → Copy your API key. OR use api.metals.live (no key required, free). Used for live gold/silver/platinum/palladium prices.
Go to alphavantage.co → Get Free API Key → Copy key. Used for live stock prices in Wealth Inventory and Yahoo Finance connection.
Go to meshy.ai → Sign up → API Keys. Used for AI-generated 3D house models in House Builder.
⚙ Owner integrations (mailing list & Notion) — not needed for testing
convertkit.com → Forms → pick your form → copy the numeric ID from the URL. API key from Account Settings → API Keys. Pioneers are added to your list automatically on sign-up.
Notion Integration Token Pioneer DB ✓ Created
1. Go to notion.so/my-integrations → New Integration → give it any name → Submit
2. Copy the Internal Integration Token (starts with ntn_ or secret_)
3. In Notion: open Vault-It Pioneer Signups DB → ··· menu → Add connections → pick your integration
All profile saves and sign-ups will auto-populate the database.

✉ EmailJS — OTP Email Delivery (optional)
Free at emailjs.com (200 emails/mo). Create a template with variables {{otp_code}} and {{to_email}}. Without this, login codes are shown on screen.
◈ Vault Network — Admin Config
Create a Payment Link in your Stripe Dashboard → set price to £7.77, one-time. Paste the link above. The NFT contract address is populated after deploying an ERC-721 to Shibarium mainnet.
☁ Cloud sync
Checking…
“Upload everything” sends all the data on this device to your account, so it appears when you sign in anywhere else.
🔐 Sign-in PIN
Set a 6-digit PIN to sign back in on any device with just your email + PIN — no email code needed. Five wrong tries lock it for 15 minutes (an email code always works).
🗂 Your data
Download a copy of your data — your figures and profile (on this device and in your account) and your latest 200 saved versions — as a file you can keep. Photos and technical security records are not in the file; email us for those. You can also read how your data is handled, or delete your account for good.
